title: SM PSS1A
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time single input PSS1A power system stabilizer, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Power system stabilizer (PSS) gain, K_S (pu)} sets the power system stabilizer gain, {PSS denominator constant for second-order block, A_1} sets the filter constant, {PSS denominator constant for second-order block, A_2} sets the filter constant, {PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant, T_1 (s)} sets the lead time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant, T_2 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant, T_3 (s)} sets the lead time constant, {PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant, T_4 (s)} sets the lag time constant, {PSS washout time constant, T_5 (s)} sets the washout time constant, {PSS transducer time constant, T_6 (s)} sets the transducer time constant, {Maximum PSS output, V_STmax (pu)} sets the maximum stabilization and {Minimum PSS output, V_STmin (pu)} sets the minimum stabilization. Values come from the instance.
